_doc: Neck anchor joint (Idle T-jxshhv): the neck root cradle (combined__neck_root_cradle, neck-head build_neck_head_connectors.py stage 1) screwed to the torso spine chassis (combined__stage1_center_torso_spine_chassis, edited by robot/body/torso/torso_screws.py build). One source for both builders and for the screws neck_parts.py generates. Frame: manifest mm. The cradle's spine plate (front face face_y_mm, rear face plate_rear_y_mm) lies flat on the rear face of a pad on the chassis (pad box, rear face = face_y_mm); 2 ISO 7380-1 M3 button heads on the plate's rear face (+y, head_side), through plain clearance holes in the plate into 2 catalogue brass M3 x 4 heat-set inserts (the same part as the head root joint, head_carrier_posts.json neck_root.insert) pressed into the pad from its rear face, flush; a tip bore of tip_bore_dia_mm runs tip_bore_depth_mm past the insert (melt and screw point). Sites: one on each side of the cradle's riser column (x -26.6 .. -20.3), the head's rim head_clear_mm off it. No sleeves, no nuts (owner 2026-11-22: catalogue hardware only). legacy: the v21 parts these replace (dropped from the manifest by neck_parts.py; their chassis sleeves by torso_screws.py).

insert.pressed_from: the pad's rear face (+y), on the bare chassis before anything is fitted
